detail.longDescription: Gleam is really cool. It is absolutely a functional language, but it kinda feels like you’re doing functional-style programming in JavaScript/TypeScript, but then you realize you’re actually doing proper FP with the backing of a wonderful (but very simple!) ML type system! If you ever tried to do functional programming but bounced off, I *highly* recommend giving Gleam a shot. It’s what truly made FP style click for me. # gleamlang # programming
